note: The list of project types. Each id has a research file at data/research/<category>/<id>.json. primaryUnit is the unit the baseline price is quoted in; altUnits are other units the engine reports. Unit ids are defined in data/research/units.json.

types.name: Single-family home (production)
types.description: Production/spec detached homes built by a builder on finished or raw lots.

types.name: Custom home
types.description: One-off architect-designed detached home; priced per conditioned SF.

types.name: Townhomes
types.description: Attached for-sale or for-rent townhouses, 2–3 stories, wood frame.

types.name: Duplex / triplex / fourplex
types.description: Small 2–4 unit missing-middle residential buildings.

types.name: Accessory dwelling unit (ADU)
types.description: Detached or attached backyard unit on an existing residential lot.

types.name: Garden multifamily
types.description: 2–4 story walk-up apartments, Type V wood frame, surface parking.

types.name: Wrap / mid-rise multifamily
types.description: 4–5 story wood-frame apartments wrapping a structured parking garage.

types.name: Podium multifamily (5-over-1/2)
types.description: Wood-frame residential floors over a concrete podium (retail/parking below).

types.name: High-rise multifamily
types.description: Concrete or steel residential tower, typically 12+ stories, structured parking.

types.name: Build-to-rent — detached
types.description: Purpose-built single-family rental community with detached homes and amenities.

types.name: Build-to-rent — attached/horizontal
types.description: Horizontal apartments / attached cottages and townhome rentals.

types.name: Student housing
types.description: Purpose-built off-campus student housing, leased by the bed.

types.name: Senior / independent living
types.description: Age-restricted independent living with common dining and amenities.

types.name: Assisted living / memory care
types.description: Licensed assisted living and secured memory care with commercial kitchen and care spaces.

types.name: Affordable / LIHTC multifamily
types.description: Income-restricted rental financed with low-income housing tax credits.

types.name: Manufactured / mobile home community
types.description: Land-lease community of manufactured-home pads with utilities and roads; homes optional.

types.name: Modular / prefab housing
types.description: Factory-built volumetric modular or panelized residential, set on site.

types.name: Co-living
types.description: Private bedrooms with shared kitchens and lounges, leased by the room.

types.name: Tiny home community
types.description: Pads with utility hookups for tiny homes (on wheels or foundation), shared amenities.

types.name: Cottage court / pocket neighborhood
types.description: Small detached cottages clustered around a shared green.

types.name: RV park / resort
types.description: Full-hookup RV sites (water, sewer, 30/50A power) with bathhouse, laundry and amenities.

types.name: Campground
types.description: Tent and partial-hookup campsites with comfort stations.

types.name: Glamping resort
types.description: Safari tents, domes or yurts on platforms with utilities and a central lodge.

types.name: Cabin / short-term rental resort
types.description: Clusters of furnished cabins operated as short-term rentals.

types.name: Container home community
types.description: Homes built from converted shipping containers on prepared pads.

types.name: Select-service hotel
types.description: Branded upscale/upper-midscale select-service hotel (e.g., Hampton/Courtyard class).

types.name: Full-service hotel
types.description: Full-service hotel with restaurants, meeting space and banquet.

types.name: Extended-stay hotel
types.description: Suite hotel with kitchenettes, limited public space.

types.name: Boutique hotel
types.description: Independent or lifestyle hotel with design-forward finishes and F&B.

types.name: Motel conversion / renovation
types.description: Renovation of an existing motel (rooms, exterior, systems) — often to boutique or housing.

types.name: Resort
types.description: Destination resort with extensive amenities, pools, spa and F&B.

types.name: Office — core & shell
types.description: Multi-tenant office building shell, lobbies, core and base MEP; TI excluded.

types.name: Office tenant improvement
types.description: Interior build-out of office space within an existing shell.

types.name: Medical office building
types.description: Outpatient medical office with heavier MEP and exam-room build-out.

types.name: Outpatient / ambulatory surgery center
types.description: Licensed ASC with operating rooms, pre/post-op and medical gases.

types.name: Urgent care clinic
types.description: Freestanding walk-in clinic with exam rooms and imaging.

types.name: Life science / lab
types.description: Lab-ready building with high floor-to-floor, heavy HVAC and lab infrastructure.

types.name: Retail strip center
types.description: Neighborhood strip shopping center shell with surface parking.

types.name: Retail pad / QSR
types.description: Freestanding quick-service restaurant on an outparcel, with drive-thru.

types.name: Drive-thru coffee
types.description: Small-format drive-thru/walk-up coffee kiosk with double drive lanes.

types.name: Restaurant — full service
types.description: Sit-down restaurant with full commercial kitchen and bar.

types.name: Bar / brewery / taproom
types.description: Taproom with brewhouse equipment, cold storage and patio.

types.name: Winery / tasting room
types.description: Tasting room with production/barrel space and event lawn.

types.name: Grocery-anchored shopping center
types.description: Neighborhood center anchored by a supermarket with in-line shops.

types.name: Big box retail
types.description: Single-tenant large-format store (50k–200k SF).

types.name: Auto dealership
types.description: Showroom, service bays and large paved display lots.

types.name: Car wash (express tunnel)
types.description: Express exterior tunnel wash with vacuum stalls and equipment package.

types.name: Gas station / convenience store
types.description: C-store with fuel canopy, dispensers and underground storage tanks.

types.name: Bank branch
types.description: Freestanding branch with drive-up lanes and vault.

types.name: Food truck park
types.description: Truck pads with utility pedestals, grease handling, restrooms, seating and shade.

types.name: Shipping container park
types.description: Retail/F&B units built from shipping containers around shared open space.

types.name: Food hall
types.description: Multi-vendor food hall with shared seating, bar and back-of-house.

types.name: Event / wedding venue
types.description: Banquet/event hall with catering kitchen and grounds.

types.name: Entertainment venue (bowling, golf sim, etc.)
types.description: Eatertainment: bowling, golf simulators, games and F&B.

types.name: Pickleball / racquet club
types.description: Indoor or covered courts with clubhouse and F&B.

types.name: Indoor / outdoor sports complex
types.description: Fieldhouse with courts plus outdoor turf fields and lighting.

types.name: Fitness center / gym
types.description: Health club with locker rooms and equipment package.

types.name: Trampoline / family entertainment center
types.description: Indoor FEC with trampolines, play structures and attractions.

types.name: Golf driving range
types.description: Hitting bays (covered or multi-level) with netting, lighting and target field.

types.name: Amphitheater
types.description: Outdoor performance venue with stage, shell and lawn/fixed seating.

types.name: Farmers market / open-air pavilion
types.description: Covered open-air pavilion structure with power, water and restrooms.

types.name: Warehouse / distribution
types.description: Bulk tilt-wall distribution, 32–40' clear, cross-dock or rear-load.

types.name: Last-mile / infill industrial
types.description: Smaller infill delivery stations with high trailer/van parking ratios.

types.name: Flex / light industrial
types.description: Small-bay flex with office finish, grade and dock doors.

types.name: Cold storage
types.description: Refrigerated/freezer warehouse with insulated envelope and refrigeration.

types.name: Self-storage — climate controlled
types.description: Multi-story climate-controlled interior-access storage.

types.name: Self-storage — drive-up
types.description: Single-story exterior-access storage buildings.

types.name: Boat / RV storage
types.description: Covered canopy and enclosed boat/RV storage with paved drive aisles.

types.name: Manufacturing plant
types.description: Light/medium manufacturing building with process utilities (excl. process equipment).

types.name: Data center
types.description: Colocation/hyperscale data center priced per kW of IT load (shell + MEP).

types.name: Truck terminal / truck parking
types.description: Cross-dock terminal and/or secured paved truck & trailer parking.

types.name: Industrial outdoor storage (IOS)
types.description: Improved stabilized/paved yard with fencing, lighting and small office.

types.name: Commercial greenhouse
types.description: Glass or poly greenhouse with environmental controls.

types.name: Vertical farm
types.description: Indoor controlled-environment farm with stacked grow systems.

types.name: Cannabis cultivation facility
types.description: Indoor licensed cultivation with HVAC/dehumidification, lighting and security.

types.name: Equestrian facility
types.description: Horse barns, covered arena, paddocks and fencing.

types.name: EV charging hub
types.description: DC fast-charging plaza with make-ready, switchgear and canopy.

types.name: Solar farm (utility / community)
types.description: Ground-mount PV priced per MWdc, incl. interconnection allowance.

types.name: Battery energy storage (BESS)

types.name: Childcare / daycare center
types.description: Licensed early-education center with classrooms and playgrounds.

types.name: K-12 charter school
types.description: Charter school building with classrooms, gym/cafetorium.

types.name: Church / house of worship
types.description: Sanctuary, fellowship hall, classrooms.

types.name: Community / recreation center
types.description: Municipal community center with gym, multipurpose rooms.

types.name: Public library
types.description: Branch library.

types.name: Fire station
types.description: Apparatus bays, living quarters and support spaces.

types.name: Marina
types.description: Floating/fixed docks, slips with power and water, fuel, bulkhead and dredging.

types.name: Boat ramp
types.description: Concrete launch ramp lanes with courtesy dock and trailer parking.

types.name: Surface parking lot
types.description: Paved surface lot with drainage, lighting and striping.

types.name: Parking garage
types.description: Freestanding above-grade precast or cast-in-place structured parking.

types.name: Mixed-use (combined components)
types.description: Two or more component types on one site with shared elements and phases.

types.name: Adaptive reuse
types.description: Converting an existing building to a new use (e.g., office-to-residential).

types.name: Renovation / rehab
types.description: Same-use renovation of an existing building (interior, systems, envelope).

types.name: Interior finish-out / TI (general)
types.description: Generic interior build-out of a commercial shell (retail, restaurant, general).

types.name: Custom (built from blocks)
types.description: Anything that doesn't fit a template — assembled from cost building blocks.
